name: Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
description: Perform enrichment analysis for a list of genes, with optional background gene set and plotting functionality.
detailed_description: Perform enrichment analysis for a list of genes, with optional background gene set and plotting functionality.
when_to_use: When you need gene set enrichment analysis analysis

parameters.genes: [Required] List of gene symbols to analyze (list)
parameters.top_k: [Optional] Number of top pathways to return (default: 10)
parameters.database: [Optional] Database to use for enrichment analysis (e.g., pathway, transcription, ontology) (default: ontology)
parameters.background_list: [Optional] List of background genes to use for enrichment analysis
parameters.plot: [Optional] Generate a bar plot of the top K enrichment results (default: False)
